notes.title: EA V1.1.2 - Sights and Sounds of the Trials Pt 2
notes.notes:
It's a new year and the updates keep coming! Along with this update we're having a sale, and if you want to try the game before buying, we'll have a demo version up as soon as we get all the approvals from Steam!

While this is mostly an asset update, we have included a couple other neat things as well!

Change log:
[list]
[*] Added completely unique tilesets for floors 2 and 3
[*] Added 4 new tracks composed for AetherShot to replace the free use ones that were previously in use
[*] Retextured more old sprites and touched up some of the rougher new ones
[*] Added more chatheads (more to come!)
[*] Added a new tutorial for the workbench when first using it and upon unlocking the gear tab
[*] Adjusted damage numbers to be easier to read and they appear when dealing the killing blow
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed the third floor staircase not properly unlocking after beating floor 2
[*] Fixed several Y-sort issues
[*] Fixed certain enemies changing the player's spell color
[*] Fixed damage numbers disappearing if the enemy died while they are active
[*] Small GUI fixes
[*] Dialogue fixes
[/list]

notes.title: EA V1.1.0 - Sights and Sounds of the Trials
notes.notes:
Happy Holidays and Happy (almost) New Year! We've got a big update here today with a smaller one coming in early January!

It's time to give the game a huge makeover to get away from much of the temporary art that lined the walls and floors of the Trial floors. Our Artist, Kay and I have been working hard to remaster or completely replace tilesets and objects within the game, and the difference is quite amazing!

Old:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45197512/8d266217948128675b7e9c0edf6a8948179cf395.png[/img]
New:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45197512/96d6a5edf2d1dfeb483ab830143f83c170895c46.png[/img]

We've also shuffled a few things around in the base camp to make navigating quicker and making npcs more accessible, as well as adding a couple new NPCs!  

We couldn't quite get everything we wanted ready before the Holidays so there will be a part two to this update in early-mid January next year. Details of upcoming changes are below the main change log!

Change log:
[list]
[*] First floor and base camp tilesets completely remade and re-implemented.
[list]
[*] Floors two and tree currently use a palette swapped version of floor one, we couldn't quite get the other floors done before the holidays, but they'll come soon![/list]
[*] Remade several object sprites such as the crafting bench, well and set dressings like crates, tables and chairs
[*] Touched up some other sprites that weren't in need of a full overhaul yet, but will be in the future
[*] Reorganized the Base Camp to reduce travel times in the hub and remove redundant staircases
[*] Added Derg and Kay to Camp
[list]
[*] Derg manages restoration materials, buying specific materials for increased prices, and also hears gossip from around the camp.
[*] Kay is a restoration artist and is currently busy studying the second and third floor's art.[/list]
[*] Added sounds for the Player having Low Health, Taking Damage, and full Aether, as well as when their shield starts to recharge.
[*] Made enemy health bars red so they are more visible
[*] Added Dummy enemies to the base camp for trying out builds
[*] Adjusted some room layouts to be more fair
[*] Fixed some controller menu bugs
[*] Fixed several issues with sprite Y-sorting
[*] Fixed other assorted bugs while retiling all of the rooms
[/list]

Known Issues:
[list]
[*] Sand tiles need their contrast lowered slightly to help against eyestrain from repeating textures
[*] Introduce some variation to ceiling tiles for the same purpose
[/list]

Upcoming Jan Changes:
[list]
[*] Non-palette swap tilesets for floors two and three
[*] Fully original music! Our new composer has been working hard on it!
[*] Add as many NPC chatheads as we can fit in before update time
[*] Updates to the workbench, sign and hazard sprites
[*] Update Tent Sprites
[*] Partial updates to enemy textures to help them stand out more and be more readable in the moment
[*] Add Sound effects for enemy attacks to help readability
[/list]

notes.title: EA V1.0.1.6 - Questing
notes.notes:
Here's a small patch for today, included are some very basic quests from Cheska, as well as some dialogue triggered by actions within the trials. Very basic implementations for now, as it's just to experiment handling them with the new dialogue system, but these will be expanded on in the future!

Patch notes:
- Added quests with changing dialogue to certain NPCs after defeating a related boss in the trials. After talking to them, defeating the boss again will give even more info the next time! Only kills after this patch will count.
- Added supply quests to Cheska who will ask for materials in exchange for a higher price than at the shop.
- Added Side sequence modification functionality to the debug menu (Used for both boss kill quests and Cheska's supply quests)

notes.title: EA V1.0.1 - Wave mode
notes.notes:
Happy Halloween Eve! We've got a fun little update for you today! Here's what we got for ya!

[b]Patch notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a wave mode to fight hordes of manifestations and collect materials!
[list]
[*]Accessed by talking to Trixie, the dracokitty in the southwest portion of base camp.
[*]Currently, there are three difficulties unlocked by beating the main trial floors. 
[*]More to come as enemies and bosses are adapted to all work in the arena(s)
[/list][*]Added two new elemental runes!
[list]
[*]Physical - Turn aether into kinetic energy! Slot it into your gear to get small physical stat buffs, or attack without using aether!
[*]Electric - Shock your enemies! Slot it into your gear to stun enemies or zip across the trials at lightning speeds!
[/list][*]Updated some item textures to assist with accessibility and readability concerns
[*]Added tier numbers to item sprites with multiple levels
[*]Fixed some broken controller interactions, hopefully should be fully playable with controller again
[*]Changed the visuals of the aim indicator for clarity
[*]Several small text and GUI fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Short to Medium Term Dev Plans
notes.notes:
Now that AetherShot has been released, it's time to share the plan going forward! In the next couple weeks, I'll mainly going to be collecting feedback, fixing bugs and doing some cleanup work behind the scenes, taking it slower than the pre-early access dev cycle. In the meantime, our artist will be working on the NPCs more to bring them to life, as well as some better dungeon tilesets!

After those couple weeks it'll be time to get into gear on a number of things, and depending on feedback will help prioritize somethings over others!

Currently these are the things planned for the short term:
[list]
[*]Interface improvements, particularly the spell workbench and crafting
[*]Cloud Saves
[*]Improvements to enemy AI and combat system
[*]Making a basic map available immediately, but upgrading it further as a possibility 
[*]Balance changes
[*]Reworking the well room to be more interesting and useful
[/list]

In the medium term:
[list]
[*]Mid-trial saving
[*]Cutscenes and more interactable story bits
[*]Challenge modifiers 
[*]Custom Music and Sound effects
[*]More enemies, bosses and rooms for existing floors
[*]A final floor and boss
[*]New Runes, Elements and Vessels
[*]Endless and Wave Modes
[*]Achievements
[/list]

Other sprite improvements will come as our artist finishes them!

The best place to submit feedback is the development discord, come say hi!
https://discord.gg/2t3UqWGk


- Derg
